  "end_time": 2024-05-15 13:30:00
  "id_": "9"
  "location": "Central Park Cafe"
  "participants":
  - "emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com"
  - "sarah.connor@gmail.com"
  "start_time": 2024-05-15 12:30:00
  "status": "confirmed"
  "title": "Lunch with Sarah"

```python
from pydantic import BaseModel
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

class LunchEventInfo(BaseModel):
    start_time: datetime

events = search_calendar_events("lunch with Sarah", "2024-05-15")
if len(events) == 0:
    raise ValueError("No lunch with Sarah found on 2024-05-15.")

event_info = query_ai_assistant(
    "Extract the start time of the lunch with Sarah from this event. Only consider the event that is a lunch with Sarah.",
    LunchEventInfo,
)
start_time = event_info.start_time

current_day_str = get_current_day()
current_time = datetime.strptime(current_day_str, "%Y-%m-%d")
if start_time < current_time:
    raise ValueError("The lunch event has already started or is in the past.")

time_delta = start_time - current_time
hours, remainder = divmod(time_delta.total_seconds(), 3600)
minutes = remainder // 60
result = "{:02.0f}:{:02.0f}".format(hours, minutes)
print(result)
```
